_meta.name: English
login.title: Sign in
admin.title: Administration
admin.error.invalid_user: Username is required and the password must be long enough.
admin.error.self_disable: You can't disable your own account.
login.error.throttled: Too many failed attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
login.error.sso_failed: Single sign-on failed. Please try again.
login.error.not_allowed: Your account isn't allowed to use this app. Ask an administrator for access.
login.error.conflict: An account with this username already exists here. Ask an administrator.
login.error.sso_unavailable: The sign-in service is unreachable right now. Try again later.
login.sso_down_use_ad: Single sign-on is unavailable right now. Sign in with your Windows (AD) account below.
login.error.use_sso: Please use the single sign-on button above.
login.error.directory_unavailable: The company directory (AD) is unreachable right now. Try again later.
dir.title: Login methods & Active Directory
dir.error.bad_url: Server addresses must start with ldaps:// (or ldap:// with StartTLS).
dir.now_sso: users sign in with single sign-on. AD passwords are not accepted while SSO works.
dir.now_both_ad_preferred: AD passwords are accepted (AD is preferred). The SSO button is shown too.
dir.now_ad: users sign in with their AD (Windows) password.
dir.now_local_only: only local accounts can sign in (break-glass admin, test account).
dir.rule: Rule: if SSO and AD both work, the preferred one is used. If only one works, that one is used. Status is re-checked every 30 seconds.
dir.servers: Domain controllers (one per line, tried in order)
dir.servers_hint: ldaps://dc01.corp.local:636. If the DC's certificate comes from your internal CA, put that CA in deploy/ca/.
dir.start_tls: Use StartTLS (only for ldap:// addresses on port 389)
dir.secret_hint: Stored only in secrets/ldap_bind_password on the server, never here. The fingerprint changes when the password changes. After editing the file: ./darkside app restart api
dir.group_hint: The group's sAMAccountName (e.g. darkside-admins), or its full DN. Matched exactly.
dir.preferred_hint: Single sign-on keeps MFA in front of every login; AD passwords alone don't.
dir.verify_ad_hint: Checks each DC, the certificate, the service account and the search base. With a username it shows what a login would see (groups, required/admin group); with a password it also checks that password. Nothing is stored.
rec.title: Recordings
rec.consent: I have told everyone present and they agree
rec.dsp: Browser noise suppression / echo cancellation (leave off for conference mics like the XVF3800)
rec.keep_open: Keep this tab open and in front while recording; on phones keep the screen on.
rec.status_offline: offline: keeps recording, will upload when back
rec.err_consent: Please confirm everyone present agrees to the recording first.
rec.err_session: Your session ended. Log in again; the recording so far is kept.
rec.confirm_delete: Move this recording to the trash? It is removed for good after 30 days.
tx.no_names: No names found in the transcript.
svc.title: Services: transcription & LLM
svc.auto_transcribe: Transcribe automatically when a recording is saved
svc.channel_hint: Channel: mix (all channels) or a channel number
svc.diarize: Identify speakers (needs HF_TOKEN on the service)
svc.key_hint: Only in secrets/llm/llm_api_key on the server, never here. Leave it out if your LLM needs no key. After changing it: ./darkside app restart api worker-llm
svc.max_chars_hint: Longer transcripts are done in parts: notes per part first, then the answer from the notes.
svc.verify_hint: Uses the saved settings. Verify LLM also sends one tiny test question.
svc.prompts_hint: Placeholders: {language} (the transcript's language), {transcript}, {question}. Literal braces must be doubled: {{ }}.
svc.error.bad_url: Service URLs must start with http:// or https://.
svc.error.bad_channel: Default channel must be 'mix' or a channel number.
svc.error.bad_prompt: A prompt has an unknown {placeholder}. Use {language}, {transcript}, {question}; double literal braces.
login.lede: Record meetings, get transcripts and notes — on your own servers.
notfound.title: Not found
notfound.body: This page doesn't exist, or it isn't yours to see.
rec.list_lede: Your meetings, newest first. Only you can see them.
rec.empty_hint: Start a new recording, or upload a file you already have.
rec.hint_allow: Allow the microphone below, then press the red button.
rec.hint_ready: Ready. Press the red button to start.
rec.hint_recording: Recording. Press the button again to stop.
tx.working: Transcribing… this page updates by itself.
tx.insights_wait: Insights are available once the transcript is ready.
tx.insights_empty: Pick an insight above, or ask your own question.
admin.create_user_hint: Local accounts are for emergencies and testing. Everyone else signs in with SSO or AD.
admin.jobs_hint: The 20 most recent background jobs. Updates by itself while something runs.
dir.ad_settings_hint: Direct sign-in with Windows (AD) passwords, without SSO.
dir.problem.plain_ldap: use ldaps://, or ldap:// with StartTLS (plain LDAP is refused)
svc.asr_hint: The WhisperX service that turns audio into text.
svc.llm_hint: Any OpenAI-compatible server: vLLM, Ollama, LM Studio, a cloud API…
step.note.user_not_found: not found (or more than one match)
step.note.no_diarize: no 'diarize': engine isn't whisperx or HF_TOKEN missing on the service
step.note.key_none: none (fine if your LLM needs no key)
err.login_required: Your session ended. Sign in again.
err.quota: Your storage quota is full. Delete old recordings first.
err.consent: Please confirm everyone present agrees to the recording first.
err.bad_seq: A piece of the recording was out of order.
err.conflict: A piece arrived twice with different content.
err.bad_channel: Channel must be 'mix' or a channel number.
err.no_transcript: There is no finished transcript yet.
err.asr_not_set: The transcription service isn't set up yet (Admin → Services).
err.asr_unreachable: The transcription service can't be reached.
err.asr_http: The transcription service answered with error {status}.
err.asr_not_json: The transcription service sent an answer that isn't JSON.
err.asr_no_segments: The transcription service's answer has no segments.
err.llm_not_set: The LLM isn't set up yet (Admin → Services).
err.llm_bad_reply: The LLM's answer isn't an OpenAI chat completion.
err.no_such_channel: Channel {n} was requested but the recording has {channels}.
err.os: The server couldn't read the audio file.
err.no_speakers: Speakers were requested but the service returned none (HF_TOKEN set on the service?).
svc.banned_hint: Language codes, e.g. az (Whisper often hears Turkish as Azerbaijani). Used when the language is set to auto.
svc.fallback_hint: When detection picks a banned language, transcribe in this one, e.g. tr.
svc.error.bad_language: Languages must be codes like tr, en or az.
svc.error.fallback_required: Choose a language to use instead of the banned ones.
svc.error.fallback_banned: The language to use instead can't be one of the banned ones.
ask.title: Ask
ask.lede: Ask about one or more of your meetings, with follow-up questions.
ask.followup: Ask a follow-up… (Enter sends, Shift+Enter for a new line)
ask.pick_hint: Only meetings with a finished transcript are listed. The bar shows how much of the allowed context they use.
ask.question: Your question
ask.budget_over: Too much: {pct}% of the allowed context. Pick fewer meetings.
ask.no_sources: No meeting has a finished transcript yet.
ask.confirm_delete: Delete this chat? The meetings themselves are kept.
ask.with_others: Ask about this and other meetings
svc.chat_max_chars_hint: Meetings + earlier turns + the question, per request. Keep it below what your model can take (roughly 3–4 characters per token). Meetings that don't fit can't be picked; the oldest turns are dropped first.
err.chat_not_ready: A selected meeting has no finished transcript.
err.chat_too_large: Too much for one question: {used} of {limit} characters. Pick fewer meetings.
err.chat_busy: Wait for the answer before asking again.
